text:
emma_sales: Hey team — ACME's infosec sent a follow-up: they want concrete evidence for logging/audit controls for the POC. Specifically: admin activity logging (who did what), retention policy (12 months), SIEM ingest options, and a few red-team-resistant sample log entries. Can we pull together a short bundle they can review by EOD?

raj_security: Thanks Emma. Quick Qs: do they need exported logs or an attestation + config snippets? Also confirm if they want proof for hosted (Redwood API) or Dedicated/Private.

emma_sales: Hosted first (they'll evaluate Dedicated later). Ideally: 1) short attestation PDF saying we retain admin logs 12 months, 2) example log lines for admin actions, 3) small guide for forwarding logs to customer SIEM (syslog/HTTPS), 4) list of controls (RBAC, key rotation) + where logs live.

mike_sre: I can generate sample logs + a snippet of the export API. We ship admin/audit events to our audit store (immutable S3 with versioning + retention) and we stream to Kafka for SIEM forwarders. For hosted POC we can show a 30-day live export + archived 12-month retention record.

mike_sre: here's a minimal curl to pull admin audit events for an account (scrubbed):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDACTED" \
  'https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/admin/audit?org_id=acme-corp&start=2025-10-01T00:00:00Z&end=2025-10-31T23:59:59Z' \
  -o acme-admin-audit.json
```

mike_sre: sample log lines (JSONL) — timestamps and ids redacted: 
```json
{"timestamp":"2025-10-01T13:12:02Z","event":"api_key.create","actor":"user:alice@acme.com","target":"org:acme-corp","request_id":"req_XXXX","ip":"203.0.113.45"}
{"timestamp":"2025-10-05T09:22:17Z","event":"model.deploy","actor":"user:bob@acme.com","target":"model:llama-35b","request_id":"req_YYYY","notes":"canary rollout v2"}
{"timestamp":"2025-10-07T21:03:10Z","event":"policy.change","actor":"system:admin-service","target":"org:acme-corp","request_id":"req_ZZZZ","details":{"from":"allow","to":"restrict"}}
```

raj_security: This looks good. For the SIG/CAIQ bits we usually include: retention location (S3, GCP bucket), immutability/versioning, access controls (who can read/restore), encryption at rest (KMS), and how tamper evidence is shown (checksums + object lock). Can we add a one-paragraph explanation for each control?

nina_pre-sales: I'll assemble the one-pager. Mike — can you also paste the IAM roles that can read the audit store and the offboarding process for access? Customers often ask for proof that privileged roles are limited.

mike_sre: sure — RBAC roles: audit_reader (read-only, no deletion), audit_admin (can configure retention but can't delete archived objects), infra_service (write-only for ingestion). Offboarding: access revoked via our IdP provisioning automation; we push logs to a remote immutable bucket and keep a signed manifest each month.

raj_security: For SIEM integration steps for ACME, simplest path: outbound HTTPS webhook to their collector or configure our syslog-gateway. Example syslog config (rsyslog) below: 
```conf
# /etc/rsyslog.d/50-redwood.conf
module(load=\"imuxsock\")
module(load=\"omfwd\")
*.* action(type=\"omfwd\" Target=\"siem.acme.example\" Port=\"514\" Protocol=\"tcp\" TCP_Framing=\"octet-counted\")
```

emma_sales: Perfect. Nina/raj — can we aim to send the bundle (attestation PDF + examples + one-pager + API curl) to ACME by 18:00 PT? I'll include a note that we can provide a time-limited live export if they want to validate ingestion.

nina_pre-sales: Yep. I'll draft the attestation and one-pager and ping legal for the signature.

logbot: Monthly audit manifest created: s3://redwood-audit-manifests/2025-10-manifest.sig

emma_sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the POC checklist and cc ACME. :thumbsup:
